title: Started the apprenticeship
description: Four years of Swiss vocational training — school two days a week, production code the other three. Nothing teaches you how software actually gets built like shipping it while you are still learning the language it is written in.

title: Internship at 2sic
description: My first properly large codebase, built around a rule that every interaction has to land in under a second. Working inside someone else's architecture — and being held to that number — changed how I write my own.

title: Graduated
description: Qualified as a software developer, with the Berufsmaturität in economics alongside it. Four years of work behind me, and a much clearer idea of what I wanted to build next.

title: Rekrutenschule
description: Eighteen weeks of basic military service. No IDE, no keyboard, no way to solve a problem by reading the docs — and a genuinely useful reset on discipline and getting things done as part of a team.

title: Shipped my own SaaS
description: A universal log parser and visualiser for developers, as a desktop app for macOS and Windows. The first product where every decision is mine — the parser core, the pricing page, and everything I got wrong in between.

title: Back to school, on purpose
description: Studying computer science alongside the work. Four years of building things taught me what I can do; this is for the parts I only know how to look up.
